result:
I’d make it so no one had to spend their life merely trying to survive.

Enough food. A safe place to sleep. Care when they’re sick. Freedom from violence. Not a guarantee of happiness, and not a world where everyone wants the same things—just a floor beneath which nobody falls.

So much of what people might become gets lost to hunger, fear, and exhaustion. I’d change that, then leave people free to decide what to do with the room it gives them.
